version.changelog:
Version 1.0.41

- No file changes detected in this release.
- No modifications to features, documentation, or usage examples.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only A/B test analyzer whose declared purpose matches its instructions and it requests no credentials or installs; nothing in the bundle suggests hidden behavior, but the source is unknown and there's no code to audit, so test cautiously.

dimensions.detail: Name, description, and examples describe A/B analysis and the SKILL.md only references importing a CSV, running analysis, and producing reports — all consistent with the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are limited to running the skill via the platform (openclaw run) and operating on an input CSV; they do not reference unrelated files, env vars, or external endpoints. Note: the instructions assume you will provide test_data.csv — avoid uploading sensitive or PII data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files are present (instruction-only), so nothing will be downloaded or written to disk by the skill bundle itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths and the SKILL.md does not reference any — requested privileges are minimal and proportional.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request persistent system presence or modify other skills; autonomous invocation is allowed by default on the platform but is not a red flag here by itself.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and low-risk, but you should: (1) confirm you trust the skill author/source before sending real data (source/homepage are missing), (2) test with synthetic or anonymized CSVs first to verify behavior and outputs, (3) avoid uploading PII or sensitive production data to the skill until you understand where data is processed/stored, and (4) note a small metadata mismatch (skill.json version is 1.0.0 while registry shows 1.0.41) — if provenance matters, ask the publisher for clarification or a signed/referenced release before wide use.
